description: Defines structures, constants, and functions for iterating over directory trees, including recursive traversal, path management, and iteration control flags.

methods.name: dir_iterator_begin
methods.description: Initializes a directory iterator for a given path with specified flags.

methods.name: dir_iterator_advance
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next path in the directory traversal.

methods.name: dir_iterator_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the directory iterator.
